subject.title: Feature - Implement paid certificate or badge for a manual review and approval of skills

question: Should ClawHub offer a paid expedited human-review certificate or badge for skills, and should that signal be distinct from Official publisher status and the vetted-community review path?
rationale: The current code can technically support badges and manual moderation, but choosing a paid public security assurance signal requires product, security, operations, payment, and wording decisions that source inspection cannot settle.

options.title: Fold Into Trust Policy First
options.body: Resolve the broader trust and review semantics before adding payment or a public certificate badge, then implement only the approved signal.

options.title: Approve A Paid Pilot
options.body: Sponsor a narrow paid skill-review pilot with explicit criteria, expiry, revocation, SLA/refund policy, audit logs, and public wording before coding.

options.title: Reject Paid Certificates
options.body: Document that ClawHub will not sell review certificates and keep trust signals limited to Official, scan, moderation, and non-paid review artifacts.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Trust Policy First
recommendation.body: Resolve the broader trust and review semantics before adding payment or a public certificate badge, then implement only the approved signal.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick owns the current badge/manual-review baseline in blame and is explicitly connected to adjacent trust-policy discussions.
